PERMISSION_DENIED: The operation is not authorized by the host.
Ask the operator to configure the required scope or authorized roots.
LIBRARY_NOT_INSTALLED: The required library is not installed.
Install the exact library through an authorized administrator.
LIBRARY_VERSION_MISMATCH: The library version does not match the contract.
Select an exact version allowed by the native semantics.
SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED: The field does not satisfy its contract.
Read the field contract and correct the indicated field.
UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTIC_TYPE: This native semantic type is not supported.
Choose a supported field or extend the semantic validator.
STALE_PREPARATION: Prepare the activity again before exporting.
ASSET_NOT_FOUND: Supply an existing file within the authorized asset roots.
ASSET_TOO_LARGE: Media exceeds the configured byte budget.
Reduce the media size before preparing again.
MIME_MISMATCH: The declared media type is invalid or mismatches its bytes.
Use a supported MIME type matching the actual file.
UNSAFE_ARCHIVE: The archive failed the safety checks.
Rebuild the archive with safe unique paths and bounded entries.
HUB_UNAVAILABLE: Retry later or use the installed catalog.
TARGET_INCOMPATIBLE: The library is incompatible with the target.
Select a runnable library compatible with the configured H5P Core.
BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: The backend could not complete the operation.
Ask the administrator to check backend setup and local logs.
BACKEND_TIMEOUT: Retry with a smaller workload or after the backend becomes available.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Ask the administrator to inspect the local logs.
LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The configured workload limit was exceeded.
Reduce the input size or nesting depth.
